verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of a JetBrains plugin, interactive diffs inside JetBrains, or sharing selected code as context from a JetBrains IDE. The closest items are adjacent features that do not earn credit: an embedded cloud IDE, a Desktop app that imports VS Code/Cursor settings, and an MCP server any MCP-compatible IDE could connect to.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view interactive diffs and share selected code as context from within my JetBrains IDE
